title: Monolith Ownership Extraction Schema
description: End-to-end ownership extraction for the monolith prompt. Flat directed ownership graph (nodes + edges) grounded to the client, plus cycles and conflicts. Based on the multi-agent W1 extraction schema. Every node and edge carries the source document name + path.

client_entity.description: The client entity the structure is anchored to (Layer 0). Carried from clientEntityName input.

entity_type_category.description: The CLIENT entity's KYC classification, decided first (system rules 5 + 6). Drives extraction behaviour (e.g. Category 2 listing stop, Category 3 SPV/Trust roles).

nodes.description: Every entity/person found across all documents. One node per distinct entity even if it appears in multiple documents or multiple ownership paths (do NOT duplicate; create separate edges instead).

id.description: Slug: lowercase name, spaces to underscores. Stable across all edges referencing this entity.

name.description: Legal name exactly as stated in the document.

entity_classification.description: Structural tag per system rule 4.3 ENTITY CLASSIFICATION. Captures GP/LP/Fund Vehicle roles the legal type alone does not convey.

entity_type_category.description: Per-node KYC category. Drives what to extract for this entity (e.g. Cat 3 SPV/Trust roles).

layer.description: Ownership layer relative to the client. Layer 0 = client, Layer 1 = direct owners of client, Layer 2 = their owners, etc. (system rule 4.1).

document_name.description: Name of the source document this entity record was extracted from.

document_path.description: GCS path / file path of the source document this entity record was extracted from.

proof_source.description: Source document name + section/page evidencing the listing.

listing_proof.description: Populate for Listed entities only (Category 2 / system rule 6 step 1). null otherwise.

data_gaps.description: Missing data for this entity (e.g. missing %, incomplete layer), with document reference. Empty string if none.

exceptions.description: Exceptions/special handling for this entity (e.g. orphan SPV no ownership identified, 'Share Trustee identified - add as IBO'). Empty string if none.

classification_reasoning.description: Entity type reasoning + the document page/section that evidences this entity.

edges.description: Every ownership relationship found, in whatever direction the document states. owner -> owned. Multiple owners of one entity = multiple edges into it (multi-path/convergence per system rule 4.3). Never collapse paths.

owner.description: id of the entity that holds the stake.

owned.description: id of the entity whose stake is held.

ownership_percentage_direct.description: Direct % exactly as stated (e.g. '55%', '12.5%'). 'Not Available' if absent, 'Negligible' for <=0.01%, or 'CONFLICT - see conflicts array' for material disagreements. Never assume (system rules 4.3 Percentage / 9).

gp_lp_role.description: GP/LP role of the owner in this relationship where applicable (system rule 4.2).

control.description: Control / domination indicator, ONLY when supported by evidence (system rule 9). Empty string if no evidenced control.

source.description: Document name + page/section evidencing this relationship.

source_type.description: Provenance within the document: read from a visual org chart, or from non-chart text (registers, tables, prose).

document_name.description: Name of the source document this relationship was extracted from.

document_path.description: GCS path / file path of the source document this relationship was extracted from.

direction_proof.description: Text/visual evidence proving the owner->owned direction (the page/section or chart annotation stating who owns whom).

cycles.description: Structural cycles detected by DFS over the directed edge graph (an entity reachable from itself via ownership links).

cycle_path.description: Ordered list of node ids forming the cycle.

source.description: Document reference(s) for the edges forming the cycle.

conflicts.description: Conflicting ownership values for the same owner->owned relationship across documents. Capture ALL conflicting values with sources; do NOT resolve (system rule 4.3 Data Conflict / 8).

resolution_strategy.description: Always 'deferred' — the monolith does not resolve conflicts.

data_gaps.description: Document- or structure-level gaps and exceptions not tied to a single node (incomplete layers, missing documents, unresolved entity type), per output section 8.4. Empty array if none.

document_name.description: Related document name, or 'Not Available' if not document-specific.

document_path.description: Related document path, or 'Not Available' if not document-specific.

outOfBounds.description: Records and documents that were identified but fall outside the defined scope of ownership extraction (mirrors the CSM outOfBounds capture). Empty arrays + empty summary if none.

summary.description: Start with the document name, then give an overall summary of the out-of-bounds records (names / legalName where available, document name, reason, status). Empty string if none.

documents.description: Documents identified but out of scope.

reason.description: Why this document is considered out of bounds.

records.description: Entities/records identified but out of scope.

id.description: Node id (slug) this record refers to, or a unique id if it is not an emitted node.

reason.description: Why this record is considered out of bounds.

qaFlags.description: Quality-assurance and inference flags from the document analysis (mirrors the CSM qaFlags capture). Empty array + empty summary if none.

summary.description: Start with the document name, then give an overall summary of the QA flag records. Empty string if none.

records.description: Quality-assurance and inference flag reasons based on the document analysis.

reason.description: A clear explanation of the QA / inference flag.
